data_mining.note: Positioning + macro data untuk momentum model (Phase 4). Per-coin: 200 bar/hourly, target 4,000+ bar/6 bulan. Macro: daily, langsung tersedia. ETF flow butuh Dune API key (gratis 1k queries/bulan).

guardian.note: ic32_guardian_continuation_v1: 32 feat (22 static + 10 dynamic). Flow/momentum HOLD override. OOF PF 1.59 vs clean_v2 1.48.

controller.note: Emergency brake: block counter-trend di TRENDING jika trending > 20% bars. Toggle manual via config.

hmm.note: GaussianHMM 4-state walk-forward OOF. IC=-0.074 di LGBM. Juga mengontrol regime_alignment (FLIP).

note: FLIP alignment: RANGING=counter-trend, TRENDING=with-trend. LSTM ON survival filter. Guardian clean_v2 min_hold=2. Validated 2026-06-06: holdout WR 67.5% PF 2.54, extended +59% vs baseline. Z3 dual_dominant dicabut — terlalu selektif (81 trade/5koin/bln).

regime_alignment.note: FLIP: HMM regime-aware trend alignment. RANGING(1,2) counter-trend swing mode. TRENDING(0,3) with-trend momentum mode. Satu model, dua mode, tanpa retrain. + PnL (59% improvement) di extended backtest 63 bulan.

extended_63mo.note: Per-fold retrained models. Trending market (2021) tetap loss. Tanpa positioning data, tidak ada model yang bisa profit di trending.

trend_alignment.note: Disabled — digantikan regime_alignment. h4_trend alignment lama (counter-trend always) kalah di extended backtest (- vs - dengan FLIP).
